content.text: As a digital creator in Nigeria, Ghana, or Kenya, you've likely faced the frustration of waiting weeks for PayPal or Stripe to process your payments, or worse, being locked out of payment processing altogether due to restrictions. The truth is, these platforms are designed to favor established [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-creators-ghana-get-paid-online-step-step-2|creators]], leaving innovators and those in restricted regions to rely on workarounds that compromise their sovereignty and profits.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-setting-up-nowpayments-digital-store-works-how-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

You need [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-2|COREMERCH guide to infrastructure]] that works in your favor, not against it. Core Merch's sovereign digital commerce stacks are designed to give you full control over your online store, payment processing, and data ownership, eliminating the risks and fees associated with relying on third-party platforms like Stripe or PayPal. By leveraging open-source tools and scalable [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-how-creators-ghana-get-paid|The Real]], you can deploy a fully functional digital store in hours, not weeks, and start receiving payments instantly.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you deploy, you need to have a digital product ready for sale, such as an ebook, course, or software. You'll also need to choose a cryptocurrency to accept payments in, like USDT on Tron or Solana. Additionally, you'll need to set up a NOWPayments account, which will provide you with a unique API key and webhook URL. Don't worry, these steps are easy to follow and will be covered in detail in this guide.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Once you have your product and NOWPayments account set up, it's time to configure your payment and delivery pipeline. This involves setting up a Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages site, deploying a Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script backend, and integrating NOWPayments with your chosen cryptocurrency. By following this guide, you'll learn how to set up a seamless payment experience for your customers, with instant delivery of your digital products.
You can deploy a fully functional digital store in hours, not weeks, with Core Merch's sovereign digital commerce stacks.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

The fee structure of NOWPayments is fundamentally different from conventional platform fees. NOWPayments charges 0.5% per transaction. There is no monthly fee, no setup fee, no payout fee, and no minimum transaction volume requirement. Network fees for the underlying blockchain transaction are paid by the buyer and vary by network — Tron fees are under $0.10, Solana fees are fractions of a cent, Bitcoin fees average $1 to $5 for most transactions. For a $97 product sold through the Sovereign Starter Stack, the total transaction cost is approximately $0.49 to NOWPayments plus network fees typically under $0.10 on Tron. Compare this to Gumroad's 10% fee on the same transaction — $9.70.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

The transaction log in a COREMERCH deployment provides a complete, independently verifiable audit trail of every payment. Each entry includes the transaction hash, which links directly to the public blockchain record. You can verify any transaction independently on Tronscan, Etherscan, Solscan, or the relevant blockchain explorer — no platform intermediary required. If a buyer claims they paid but the transaction does not appear in your order log, you check the blockchain directly. This level of cryptographic verifiability is structurally impossible with conventional payment processors.
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

USDT is the most practical starting point for digital product sales because it eliminates price volatility from the equation. Your buyer pays in USDT and you receive USDT — one dollar in equals one dollar received, minus the Tron network fee of under $0.10 per transaction and the NOWPayments fee of 0.5%. You do not need to manage exchange rate risk or time your conversions around market movements. When you are ready to convert to local currency, you use a P2P exchange — Binance P2P operates in most countries where conventional payment platforms are unavailable and supports competitive local currency rates.
By leveraging open-source tools and scalable architecture, you can eliminate the risks and fees associated with relying on third-party platforms like Stripe or PayPal.

With this kit, you'll have everything you need to get started, from setting up your online store to scaling your payment processing. Visit our shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to learn more.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a NOWPayments digital store, follow these steps: Set up a digital product for sale, such as an ebook or course. Choose a cryptocurrency to accept payments in, like USDT on Tron or Solana. Set up a NOWPayments account and obtain a unique API key and webhook URL. Deploy a Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages site and integrate it with NOWPayments. Configure a Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script backend to manage payments and delivery. Test your store and verify your payment settings. Receive your first payment and go live.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I receive USDT payments on Tron?

To receive USDT payments on Tron, you'll need to set up a Tron wallet and obtain a TRC-20 address. Then, integrate NOWPayments with your Tron wallet to receive payments in USDT. By following the steps outlined in this guide, you'll learn how to set up a seamless USDT payment experience for your customers.
Can I use NOWPayments to accept Bitcoin payments in Nigeria?

Yes, you can use NOWPayments to accept Bitcoin payments in Nigeria. Simply set up a NOWPayments account, obtain a unique API key and webhook URL, and integrate NOWPayments with your chosen cryptocurrency. By following the steps outlined in this guide, you'll learn how to set up a seamless Bitcoin payment experience for your customers.
How do I convert Bitcoin to naira in Nigeria?

In Nigeria, you can convert Bitcoin to naira using a peer-to-peer exchange like Binance or Patricia. By following the steps outlined in this guide, you'll learn how to set up a seamless conversion process for your customers.
What is the fee structure for NOWPayments?

NOWPayments charges a flat 0.5% fee on all transactions, making it one of the most cost-effective payment processing solutions available. By following the steps outlined in this guide, you'll learn how to integrate NOWPayments with your digital store and start receiving payments instantly.
Can I use NOWPayments to accept PayPal payments?

No, NOWPayments does not support PayPal payments. Instead, you can use NOWPayments to accept a wide range of cryptocurrencies, including USDT on Tron, Solana, and many others. By following the steps outlined in this guide, you'll learn how to set up a seamless payment experience for your customers.
You'll be able to handle increased traffic and sales without breaking the bank with Core Merch's scalable digital commerce stacks.
